sn45.3:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || || Ekam antam nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sakalam
sn45.3:1.3: evidam bhante brahmacariyaṃ yad idam kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā ti || || 3.
sn45.3:2.2: sakalam evidam Sāriputta brahmacariyaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā ti || ||
sn45.3:2.3: Kalyāṇamittassetaṃ Sāriputta bhikkhave pātikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkarissati || || 4.
sn45.3:2.4: Kathañca Sāriputta bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkaroti || ||
sn45.3:3.1: Idha Sāriputta bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitam nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmim || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.3:3.2: Evaṃ kho Sāriputta bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkaroti || || 5.
sn45.3:4.1: Tad aminā petam Sāriputta pariyāyena veditabbaṃ || yathā sakalam evidam brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā || ||
sn45.3:4.2: Mamaṃ hi Sāriputta kalyānamittam āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti || jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti || maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti || sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti || ||
sn45.3:4.3: Iminā kho etaṃ Sāriputta pariyāyena veditabbaṃ || yathā sakalam evidam brahmacariyaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā ti || || 1.
